content: Mobile browser limitations: Screen Wake Lock API now supported in all major browsers (Chrome, Safari 16.4+, Firefox 126+). iOS Home Screen Web Apps require iOS 18.4+ for Wake Lock. Fullscreen API has limited iOS support - not reliable. No brightness control API exists. Background playback: JS throttled/stopped when screen off. Wake Lock is essential for cinema use case. Fallback: NoSleep.js (hidden video playback) for older browsers.
